title: Studio Interfaces on a package with no app names it by its id ("COM.QA.RECHECK · NAVIGATION", title "com.qa.recheck") though its display name is on screen — appLabel is seeded with packageId and never replaced on the no-app branch
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible defect (a machine name shown where a label exists) with a named landing and a live reproduction.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23953 · ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names · observation (ux runner; re-checked and filed under objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878)

## What happens

On the Interfaces pillar of a package that has no app yet, the empty state itself is fine ("This package has no app yet"). The rail heading and the pillar title next to it, though, show the package **id**. The package's display name ("QA Recheck") is in the top bar of the same screen. The cause is that the state holding the app label is seeded with `packageId`, and the load returns on the no-app branch before it ever sets a label.

## Reach — measured, 2/2 fresh loads

Environment: objectstack `7277c07f` (main, 2026-10-16), `examples/app-showcase` booted from a main worktree: `OS_PORT=47321 objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 47321 -d file:…/data.db`, with a fresh DB. Console: objectui `daeb77fc` (the `.objectui-sha` pin), built against `@objectstack/spec` from `a35f7a67^` (`34b740f2`), because the pin does not build on main (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23885 / #23908). `check:console-sha` matches. Playwright with `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, form sign-in as the seeded admin, and a screenshot taken before every DOM read. Code path re-read on objectui main `023087f63`, where it is still present.

1. `POST /api/v1/packages` `{"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.recheck","name":"QA Recheck","version":"1.0.0","type":"app","namespace":"recheck"},"enableOnInstall":true}` → 201. The package has no app.
2. Open `/_console/studio/com.qa.recheck/interfaces`.
3. Page text, in order: `QA Recheck` (top bar) · **`COM.QA.RECHECK · NAVIGATION`** (rail heading, upper-cased by CSS) · `This package has no app yet.` · **`com.qa.recheck`** (pillar header title) · `This package has no app yet`. Same on two fresh loads.

- **Expected:** the rail heading and the title name the package by its label ("QA Recheck · Navigation"), or use a neutral "Navigation" while no app exists.
- **Actual:** the package id.

## Where (objectui main `023087f63`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx:2982`: `const [appLabel, setAppLabel] = React.useState<I18nLabel>(packageId);`
- `:3346-3350`: `if (!name) { setAppStatus('missing'); return; }`. This returns before `setAppLabel(label)`.
- `:4633`: the rail `heading={tFormat('engine.studio.if.navHeading', locale, { app: navItemLabelText(appLabel, locale) })}`.
- `:4083-4084`: the pillar title when nothing is selected, `navItemLabelText(appLabel, locale)`.
- Two neighbouring fallbacks also end at the id: `:3334-3336` (`published[0].label ?? published[0].name ?? packageId`) and the draft path at `:3343` (`label = String(d.name)`).

## Done when

- With no app, the rail heading and title use the package's label (from the package list the top bar already reads) or a neutral heading, never the id. The label fallbacks above end at a human string. A test pins the no-app branch.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` execution seat (app-shell Studio). No spec contract change is needed: the package label is already served.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, all states: "Studio interfaces empty state heading package id instead of package name" → 6 hits, all read. #7368 (PackageSwitcher raw id on fetch failure, closed) and #11196 (label-less nav entry, closed) are neighbours. #12688 is the zh-CN rail translation. None covers this seed.

Re-checked by a cloud QA session dispatched under objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878 (maintainer ruling there, 「派云卡片复核这 7 条，授权里全部立卡。有时间间隔就行」).
